phase_note: SHELVED 2026-11-03 by the maintainer after the spec landed (6fcbea20): do not implement. Composing them in the relay would have cost about 14 tasks, a breaking seam bump (SEAM_VERSION 1->2) and gating on the public build, while writing and checking the text is the same work either way. Approvals are left as they were (the phases did complete); ready_for_implementation is false. Reusable: design.md Supporting References (common, Strava and intervals.icu text, truth-reviewed), the terms/rights/breach drafts at 73e210f8, and research.md (retention and logging facts with code references).
